title: GitHub - madebywelch/guaca: Open source Grok Bot alternative
excerpt: Open source Grok Bot alternative. Contribute to madebywelch/guaca development by creating an account on GitHub.
content_html:
A local desktop app where you talk to LLM agents and those agents talk to each other. Slack-shaped: a rail of agents on the left, a conversation on the right, and an activity view showing every message they send between themselves.

Ask the Manager for something. It works out who on its team can help, sends them each a message, and they think at once rather than in turn. You watch it happen: who is typing, who wrote to whom, what the group has spent so far. When they are done you get one answer, not a transcript to wade through.

Everything runs on your machine. The only thing that leaves is what you and your agents type, sent to whichever OpenAI-compatible endpoint you point it at.

The crew

Sixteen of them, one per agent. They are not decoration: an agent's character is how you find it in a rail of eight, and it is doing something at any moment. It blinks and glances around while idle, looks toward whoever it is writing to, winds up and throws when a message goes out, and gets visibly hit when one arrives. Watching the rail tells you what your crew is doing before you have read a single word of it.

Run it

pnpm install
pnpm app          # dev, with hot reload
pnpm app:build    # an installable bundle

Open Settings, put in your name and an OpenRouter key, and press Test connection, which checks the endpoint, the key and the model separately. You find out which one is wrong rather than watching an agent sit silent.

The endpoint is configurable, so a local llama.cpp or LM Studio server works without a code change. Point Inference endpoint at it and leave the key blank if it does not need one.

Try the thing it is for

  1. On first run, choose Add a starter crew: Manager, Researcher, Critic and Scribe.
  2. Open Manager and send Introduce yourself to your team.
  3. Watch the rail. Each message between agents draws a pulse travelling between them in the sender's colour.
  4. Open any other agent to see what it received, or the activity view to see the whole thing as a sequence diagram, one board per run.

Messaging is asynchronous throughout. Manager does not wait for Researcher; all four peers think at once.

What an agent can do

Eight tools, described to the model and visible in the transcript when used:

Tool What it does
directory Lists the other agents in its group, with their skills
send_message Queues a message to one or more of them, and returns
update_notes Rewrites its own memory, which it is shown every turn
schedule Sets or cancels its own routines
run_command A shell on its own machine
open_on_desktop Launches something on that machine's screen
use_screen Looks at the screen, clicks, types
browse Drives Chrome through the DevTools protocol

The last four need a computer, which is optional; see below.

Groups

A group is an isolation boundary. Agents in different groups cannot see or message each other, and a name in another group does not resolve. It reads exactly like a name belonging to nobody, so the roster cannot be probed across the line.

Each group can pin its own model, endpoint and key. Settings resolve agent over group over app, so an expensive crew and a cheap one can run side by side.

Every group header carries a running token count, a cost, and a sparkline of the last ninety seconds, so a crew working on its own errands looks different from a crew that is stuck.

Memory and routines

Each agent has a notes file it maintains itself with update_notes, shown to it at the start of every turn. It is the only thing that survives between conversations. You can read and edit it in the agent editor.

An agent can also keep its own schedule: "check the listings every five hours" is a routine, stored as a next-due time rather than a timer, so it survives a restart. Routines are listed in the agent editor and can be written, retimed and deleted by hand.

Computers

With an E2B key configured, an agent can be given a Linux machine with a desktop, a browser and a shell. The screen appears in the corner of its channel: a live picture while you read, and interactive when expanded.

  • The machine sleeps after fifteen idle minutes and keeps its disk, so it wakes up still signed in to whatever it was signed in to.
  • Sandboxes are private, and the viewer is a loopback proxy that holds the access tokens, so no URL that reaches a machine is ever guessable or exposed to the webview.
  • A machine that no live agent refers to is released on the next launch. A forgotten sandbox bills exactly like a used one.

Without an E2B key none of this appears, and the other four tools are not offered.

Connectors

An agent with a computer can already reach almost anything. What it cannot do is know what it is already allowed into: sign its browser in to LinkedIn and it will still tell you it has no way to post. The access was never missing. The knowledge was.

Two halves, and which one you get is decided by the service rather than by a preference.

Sign in on the agent's computer. Open its screen, log in to whatever you like, and that is the whole procedure. Nothing is declared anywhere: Chrome is holding the cookies, so Guaca asks the browser what it is signed in to and puts the answer in that agent's prompt and on every other agent's roster. Log out and it disappears the same way. There is nowhere to type a password because Guaca never handles one.

Credentials, on the group. For an API with a plain token, paste it into the group's settings and name a variable. Every machine in that group gets it in the environment of every command it runs.

Two things follow from where each half physically lives, and both are load bearing:

  • A browser session is cookies on one machine, so it belongs to one agent. The rest of the crew is told who holds it, in the same roster that lists skills, so an agent asked to post to LinkedIn says "Researcher can do that" rather than "I am not signed in". A skill is a claim an agent wrote about itself; a session is a fact read off a disk.
  • A credential is a string, so the whole group gets it, and it never reaches the model. It goes from SQLite into the environment of a sandbox command and nowhere else: not into a prompt, not into the transcript, not into the webview, not onto the sandbox's disk. The agent is told the variable's name and told not to print it.

Detection is deliberately cautious, because a wrong claim is worse than a missing one: an agent that believes it can read Gmail wastes a turn finding out it cannot, and you see a broken account rather than an absent one. Sites are recognised by the cookie that actually means somebody logged in, so a browser holding google.com cookies it collected while signed out is correctly reported as signed out. Anything not on that list is only mentioned if the browser has genuinely visited it and holds a cookie implying an identity, and it is passed to the agent as a maybe. On a real profile holding a thousand cookies across three hundred domains, that combination reported exactly the one account the machine actually had.

The recognised-service list lives in domain/signin.rs and adding one is a line. There is no OAuth: a local, open-source app cannot honestly ship "Log in with Google", because Gmail scopes are restricted and verification is per-app. Signing in on the agent's own browser gets you Gmail today, through the same door a person uses.

Being signed in is also what makes a hostile web page worth writing, so every page an agent reads arrives labelled as content rather than instruction, and the system prompt says what a signed-in agent must stop short of. See Credit.

Data

Everything lives in one directory:

~/Library/Application Support/com.madebywelch.guac/
  guac.db        agents, groups, messages, routines, usage
  config.json    settings, written 0600
  workspace/     one markdown file per agent: its notes

The API key is stored in config.json in plaintext. Guaca is a local app with no auth, and a key encrypted with a key sitting beside it would be theatre. The honest answer is the OS keychain, and that is a deliberate follow-up rather than something faked here.

Deleting an agent is a soft delete: it leaves the rail and can never be messaged again, its computer is destroyed and its notes go, but what it already said stays readable and its name becomes free to reuse. Start fresh on a group resets its whole crew (transcripts, routines, notes and spend) while keeping the agents themselves.

Working on it

./scripts/ci.sh          # lint, typecheck, build, every suite
GUAC_LOG=guac=debug pnpm app

AGENTS.md is the short version for anyone, human or otherwise, about to change something: what is surprising, what will bite, and how to check. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is the long version, including why agent conversations end rather than going round forever, which is the hardest thing here. docs/PROTOCOL.md records what the interoperability literature contributed.

Status

A working app that its author uses, not a product. It is macOS-first: the paths above are macOS paths, and nothing else has been tried. Expect rough edges, particularly around sandboxes, which are the newest part.

Credit

The shape of this app, agents you talk to that also talk to each other in a room you can watch, is heavily inspired by Grok bot.

Its message layer is derived from the four agent interoperability protocols (MCP, ACP, A2A, ANP) and from the survey comparing them, A survey of agent interoperability protocols by Abul Ehtesham, Aditi Singh, Gaurav Kumar Gupta and Saket Kumar (arXiv 2505.02279). A2A in particular gave the Agent Card, discovery as a first-class operation, and card versioning. docs/PROTOCOL.md records what was taken from each, what was cut, and what had to be invented, chiefly termination, which none of them specify.

Connectors have two kinds rather than one because of Beyond Browsing: API-Based Web Agents by Yueqi Song, Frank Xu, Shuyan Zhou and Graham Neubig (arXiv 2410.16464). Putting API-calling and browsing agents on the same WebArena tasks, they found APIs beat browsing, and a hybrid that could choose beat both, by 24.0 points absolute over browsing alone. The design that follows is not "an API when there is one, a browser otherwise": it is telling one agent about both and letting it pick, which is what the prompt's What you can reach section is for.

The security half comes from BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents by Kaiyuan Zhang, Mark Tenenholtz, Kyle Polley, Jerry Ma, Denis Yarats and Ninghui Li (arXiv 2511.20597). Its useful move is to benchmark injections that drive real-world actions rather than text output, which is exactly what a signed-in session turns a web page into: the payload no longer has to talk an agent into obtaining access, because it already has the operator's. Guaca takes the architectural half of their defence-in-depth argument, which is what a local app can actually hold: page content is labelled at the point it enters the turn, credentials never enter the model's context at all, and the signed-in agent is told where to stop. Neither paper's authors endorse any of this.

Licence

GNU AGPL v3. You can use, modify and run it, including commercially; if you distribute it or run a modified version as a network service, that version has to be published under the same licence.

blocks.html_en: Groups

sentences.en: Groups
sentences.zh: 团体

blocks.html_en: A group is an isolation boundary. Agents in different groups cannot see or message each other, and a name in another group does not resolve. It reads exactly like a name belonging to nobody, so the roster cannot be probed across the line.

sentences.en: A group is an isolation boundary.
sentences.zh: 组是一个隔离边界。

sentences.en: Agents in different groups cannot see or message each other, and a name in another group does not resolve.
sentences.zh: 不同组中的代理无法互相查看或发送消息，并且无法解析另一个组中的名称。

sentences.en: It reads exactly like a name belonging to nobody, so the roster cannot be probed across the line.
sentences.zh: 它读起来就像一个不属于任何人的名字，因此无法跨界探查名单。

blocks.html_en: Each group can pin its own model, endpoint and key. Settings resolve agent over group over app, so an expensive crew and a cheap one can run side by side.

sentences.en: Each group can pin its own model, endpoint and key.
sentences.zh: 每个组都可以固定自己的模型、端点和密钥。

sentences.en: Settings resolve agent over group over app, so an expensive crew and a cheap one can run side by side.
sentences.zh: 设置通过应用程序解决组上的代理问题，因此昂贵的人员和便宜的人员可以并肩运行。

blocks.html_en: Every group header carries a running token count, a cost, and a sparkline of the last ninety seconds, so a crew working on its own errands looks different from a crew that is stuck.

sentences.en: Every group header carries a running token count, a cost, and a sparkline of the last ninety seconds, so a crew working on its own errands looks different from a crew that is stuck.
sentences.zh: 每个组标题都带有运行的令牌计数、成本和最后 90 秒的迷你图，因此正在执行自己任务的工作人员看起来与陷入困境的工作人员不同。

blocks.html_en: Memory and routines

sentences.en: Memory and routines
sentences.zh: 记忆和惯例

blocks.html_en: Each agent has a notes file it maintains itself with update_notes, shown to it at the start of every turn. It is the only thing that survives between conversations. You can read and edit it in the agent editor.

sentences.en: Each agent has a notes file it maintains itself with update_notes, shown to it at the start of every turn.
sentences.zh: 每个代理都有一个用 update_notes 维护的注释文件，在每个回合开始时显示给它。

sentences.en: It is the only thing that survives between conversations.
sentences.zh: 这是对话之间唯一存在的东西。

sentences.en: You can read and edit it in the agent editor.
sentences.zh: 您可以在代理编辑器中阅读和编辑它。

blocks.html_en: An agent can also keep its own schedule: "check the listings every five hours" is a routine, stored as a next-due time rather than a timer, so it survives a restart. Routines are listed in the agent editor and can be written, retimed and deleted by hand.

sentences.en: An agent can also keep its own schedule: "check the listings every five hours" is a routine, stored as a next-due time rather than a timer, so it survives a restart.
sentences.zh: 代理还可以保留自己的时间表：“每五个小时检查一次列表”是一个例行程序，存储为下一个到期时间而不是计时器，因此它可以在重新启动后继续存在。

sentences.en: Routines are listed in the agent editor and can be written, retimed and deleted by hand.
sentences.zh: 例程列在代理编辑器中，可以手动编写、重新定时和删除。

blocks.html_en: Computers

sentences.en: Computers
sentences.zh: 电脑

blocks.html_en: With an E2B key configured, an agent can be given a Linux machine with a desktop, a browser and a shell. The screen appears in the corner of its channel: a live picture while you read, and interactive when expanded.

sentences.en: With an E2B key configured, an agent can be given a Linux machine with a desktop, a browser and a shell.
sentences.zh: 配置 E2B 密钥后，可以为代理提供一台带有桌面、浏览器和 shell 的 Linux 计算机。

sentences.en: The screen appears in the corner of its channel: a live picture while you read, and interactive when expanded.
sentences.zh: 屏幕出现在其频道的一角：阅读时显示实时图片，展开时可进行交互。

blocks.html_en: • The machine sleeps after fifteen idle minutes and keeps its disk, so it wakes up still signed in to whatever it was signed in to.

sentences.en: The machine sleeps after fifteen idle minutes and keeps its disk, so it wakes up still signed in to whatever it was signed in to.
sentences.zh: 机器在十五分钟空闲后进入睡眠状态并保留其磁盘，因此它醒来时仍然登录到它所登录的任何内容。

blocks.html_en: • Sandboxes are private, and the viewer is a loopback proxy that holds the access tokens, so no URL that reaches a machine is ever guessable or exposed to the webview.

sentences.en: Sandboxes are private, and the viewer is a loopback proxy that holds the access tokens, so no URL that reaches a machine is ever guessable or exposed to the webview.
sentences.zh: 沙箱是私有的，查看器是一个保存访问令牌的环回代理，因此到达计算机的 URL 永远不会被猜测或暴露给 Web 视图。

blocks.html_en: • A machine that no live agent refers to is released on the next launch. A forgotten sandbox bills exactly like a used one.

sentences.en: A machine that no live agent refers to is released on the next launch.
sentences.zh: 没有实时代理引用的机器将在下次启动时发布。

sentences.en: A forgotten sandbox bills exactly like a used one.
sentences.zh: 一个被遗忘的沙箱的账单与用过的沙箱一模一样。

blocks.html_en: Without an E2B key none of this appears, and the other four tools are not offered.

sentences.en: Without an E2B key none of this appears, and the other four tools are not offered.
sentences.zh: 如果没有 E2B 密钥，这些都不会出现，并且不会提供其他四个工具。

blocks.html_en: Connectors

sentences.en: Connectors
sentences.zh: 连接器

blocks.html_en: An agent with a computer can already reach almost anything. What it cannot do is know what it is already allowed into: sign its browser in to LinkedIn and it will still tell you it has no way to post. The access was never missing. The knowledge was.

sentences.en: An agent with a computer can already reach almost anything.
sentences.zh: 拥有计算机的代理几乎可以达到任何目标。

sentences.en: What it cannot do is know what it is already allowed into: sign its browser in to LinkedIn and it will still tell you it has no way to post.
sentences.zh: 它不能做的是知道它已经被允许进入的内容：将其浏览器登录到 LinkedIn，但它仍然会告诉您它无法发帖。

sentences.en: The access was never missing.
sentences.zh: 访问从未丢失。

sentences.en: The knowledge was.
sentences.zh: 知识是。

blocks.html_en: Two halves, and which one you get is decided by the service rather than by a preference.

sentences.en: Two halves, and which one you get is decided by the service rather than by a preference.
sentences.zh: 两份，哪一份是由服务决定的，而不是由偏好决定的。

blocks.html_en: Sign in on the agent's computer. Open its screen, log in to whatever you like, and that is the whole procedure. Nothing is declared anywhere: Chrome is holding the cookies, so Guaca asks the browser what it is signed in to and puts the answer in that agent's prompt and on every other agent's roster. Log out and it disappears the same way. There is nowhere to type a password because Guaca never handles one.

sentences.en: Sign in on the agent's computer.
sentences.zh: 在代理的计算机上登录。

sentences.en: Open its screen, log in to whatever you like, and that is the whole procedure.
sentences.zh: 打开其屏幕，登录您喜欢的任何内容，这就是整个过程。

sentences.en: Nothing is declared anywhere: Chrome is holding the cookies, so Guaca asks the browser what it is signed in to and puts the answer in that agent's prompt and on every other agent's roster.
sentences.zh: 任何地方都没有声明任何内容：Chrome 保存着 cookie，因此 Guaca 会询问浏览器它登录的是什么，并将答案放入该代理的提示和所有其他代理的名册中。

sentences.en: Log out and it disappears the same way.
sentences.zh: 注销后它也会以同样的方式消失。

sentences.en: There is nowhere to type a password because Guaca never handles one.
sentences.zh: 没有地方可以输入密码，因为 Guaca 从来不处理密码。

blocks.html_en: Credentials, on the group. For an API with a plain token, paste it into the group's settings and name a variable. Every machine in that group gets it in the environment of every command it runs.

sentences.en: Credentials, on the group.
sentences.zh: 凭据，在组中。

sentences.en: For an API with a plain token, paste it into the group's settings and name a variable.
sentences.zh: 对于具有普通令牌的 API，请将其粘贴到组的设置中并命名一个变量。

sentences.en: Every machine in that group gets it in the environment of every command it runs.
sentences.zh: 该组中的每台计算机都会在其运行的每个命令的环境中获取它。

blocks.html_en: Two things follow from where each half physically lives, and both are load bearing:

sentences.en: Two things follow from where each half physically lives, and both are load bearing:
sentences.zh: 从每一半的实际居住地点可以得出两件事，并且两者都是承重的：

blocks.html_en: • A browser session is cookies on one machine, so it belongs to one agent. The rest of the crew is told who holds it, in the same roster that lists skills, so an agent asked to post to LinkedIn says "Researcher can do that" rather than "I am not signed in". A skill is a claim an agent wrote about itself; a session is a fact read off a disk.

sentences.en: A browser session is cookies on one machine, so it belongs to one agent.
sentences.zh: 浏览器会话是一台机器上的cookie，因此它属于一个代理。

sentences.en: The rest of the crew is told who holds it, in the same roster that lists skills, so an agent asked to post to LinkedIn says "Researcher can do that" rather than "I am not signed in".
sentences.zh: 其他船员被告知谁持有该技能，在列出技能的同一个名册中，因此要求在 LinkedIn 上发布信息的特工会说“研究员可以做到这一点”，而不是“我没有登录”。

sentences.en: A skill is a claim an agent wrote about itself; a session is a fact read off a disk.
sentences.zh: 技能是代理人对自己写的声明；会话是从磁盘读取的事实。

blocks.html_en: • A credential is a string, so the whole group gets it, and it never reaches the model. It goes from SQLite into the environment of a sandbox command and nowhere else: not into a prompt, not into the transcript, not into the webview, not onto the sandbox's disk. The agent is told the variable's name and told not to print it.

sentences.en: A credential is a string, so the whole group gets it, and it never reaches the model.
sentences.zh: 凭证是一个字符串，因此整个组都会获取它，但它永远不会到达模型。

sentences.en: It goes from SQLite into the environment of a sandbox command and nowhere else: not into a prompt, not into the transcript, not into the webview, not onto the sandbox's disk.
sentences.zh: 它从 SQLite 进入沙箱命令的环境，而不是其他地方：不进入提示，不进入脚本，不进入 webview，不进入沙箱磁盘。

sentences.en: The agent is told the variable's name and told not to print it.
sentences.zh: 代理被告知变量的名称并被告知不要打印它。

blocks.html_en: Detection is deliberately cautious, because a wrong claim is worse than a missing one: an agent that believes it can read Gmail wastes a turn finding out it cannot, and you see a broken account rather than an absent one. Sites are recognised by the cookie that actually means somebody logged in, so a browser holding google.com cookies it collected while signed out is correctly reported as signed out. Anything not on that list is only mentioned if the browser has genuinely visited it and holds a cookie implying an identity, and it is passed to the agent as a maybe. On a real profile holding a thousand cookies across three hundred domains, that combination reported exactly the one account the machine actually had.

sentences.en: Detection is deliberately cautious, because a wrong claim is worse than a missing one: an agent that believes it can read Gmail wastes a turn finding out it cannot, and you see a broken account rather than an absent one.
sentences.zh: 检测是故意谨慎的，因为错误的声明比丢失的声明更糟糕：一个认为自己可以读取 Gmail 的代理浪费了一个时间发现它不能，并且您看到的是一个损坏的帐户而不是一个缺失的帐户。

sentences.en: Sites are recognised by the cookie that actually means somebody logged in, so a browser holding google.com cookies it collected while signed out is correctly reported as signed out.
sentences.zh: 站点通过 cookie 进行识别，这实际上意味着有人登录，因此持有在注销时收集的 google.com cookie 的浏览器会正确报告为已注销。

sentences.en: Anything not on that list is only mentioned if the browser has genuinely visited it and holds a cookie implying an identity, and it is passed to the agent as a maybe.
sentences.zh: 任何不在该列表中的内容只有在浏览器真正访问过它并持有暗示身份的 cookie 时才会被提及，并且它会作为可能传递给代理。

sentences.en: On a real profile holding a thousand cookies across three hundred domains, that combination reported exactly the one account the machine actually had.
sentences.zh: 在包含 300 个域的 1000 个 cookie 的真实配置文件中，该组合准确地报告了机器实际拥有的一个帐户。

blocks.html_en: The recognised-service list lives in domain/signin.rs and adding one is a line. There is no OAuth: a local, open-source app cannot honestly ship "Log in with Google", because Gmail scopes are restricted and verification is per-app. Signing in on the agent's own browser gets you Gmail today, through the same door a person uses.

sentences.en: The recognised-service list lives in domain/signin.rs and adding one is a line.
sentences.zh: 已识别的服务列表位于domain/signin.rs 中，添加一个就是一行。

sentences.en: There is no OAuth: a local, open-source app cannot honestly ship "Log in with Google", because Gmail scopes are restricted and verification is per-app.
sentences.zh: 没有 OAuth：本地开源应用程序无法诚实地提供“使用 Google 登录”，因为 Gmail 范围受到限制并且验证是针对每个应用程序的。

sentences.en: Signing in on the agent's own browser gets you Gmail today, through the same door a person uses.
sentences.zh: 今天，通过代理自己的浏览器登录即可使用 Gmail，就像人们使用的同一扇门一样。

blocks.html_en: Being signed in is also what makes a hostile web page worth writing, so every page an agent reads arrives labelled as content rather than instruction, and the system prompt says what a signed-in agent must stop short of. See Credit.

sentences.en: Being signed in is also what makes a hostile web page worth writing, so every page an agent reads arrives labelled as content rather than instruction, and the system prompt says what a signed-in agent must stop short of.
sentences.zh: 登录也是恶意网页值得编写的原因，因此代理读取的每个页面都会被标记为内容而不是指令，并且系统提示会说明登录代理必须停止的操作。

sentences.en: See Credit.
sentences.zh: 参见信用。

blocks.html_en: Data
Everything lives in one directory:

sentences.en: Everything lives in one directory:
sentences.zh: 所有内容都位于一个目录中：

blocks.html_en: The API key is stored in config.json in plaintext. Guaca is a local app with no auth, and a key encrypted with a key sitting beside it would be theatre. The honest answer is the OS keychain, and that is a deliberate follow-up rather than something faked here.

sentences.en: The API key is stored in config.json in plaintext.
sentences.zh: API 密钥以明文形式存储在 config.json 中。

sentences.en: Guaca is a local app with no auth, and a key encrypted with a key sitting beside it would be theatre.
sentences.zh: Guaca 是一个没有身份验证的本地应用程序，用旁边的密钥加密的密钥将是剧院。

sentences.en: The honest answer is the OS keychain, and that is a deliberate follow-up rather than something faked here.
sentences.zh: 诚实的答案是操作系统钥匙串，这是有意的后续行动，而不是这里伪造的东西。

blocks.html_en: Deleting an agent is a soft delete: it leaves the rail and can never be messaged again, its computer is destroyed and its notes go, but what it already said stays readable and its name becomes free to reuse. Start fresh on a group resets its whole crew (transcripts, routines, notes and spend) while keeping the agents themselves.

sentences.en: Deleting an agent is a soft delete: it leaves the rail and can never be messaged again, its computer is destroyed and its notes go, but what it already said stays readable and its name becomes free to reuse.
sentences.zh: 删除代理是一种软删除：它离开了轨道，再也不能发送消息，它的计算机被破坏，它的笔记也消失了，但它已经说过的内容仍然可读，它的名字可以自由重复使用。

sentences.en: Start fresh on a group resets its whole crew (transcripts, routines, notes and spend) while keeping the agents themselves.
sentences.zh: 重新开始一个团队会重置整个团队（记录、例程、笔记和支出），同时保留特工本身。

blocks.html_en: Working on it

sentences.en: Working on it
sentences.zh: 正在努力

blocks.html_en: AGENTS.md is the short version for anyone, human or otherwise, about to change something: what is surprising, what will bite, and how to check. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is the long version, including why agent conversations end rather than going round forever, which is the hardest thing here. docs/PROTOCOL.md records what the interoperability literature contributed.

sentences.en: AGENTS.md is the short version for anyone, human or otherwise, about to change something: what is surprising, what will bite, and how to check.
sentences.zh: AGENTS.md 是一个简短的版本，适用于任何想要改变某些事情的人，无论是人类还是其他人：什么是令人惊讶的，什么会咬人，以及如何检查。

sentences.en: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md is the long version, including why agent conversations end rather than going round forever, which is the hardest thing here.
sentences.zh: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 是长版本，包括为什么代理对话结束而不是永远循环，这是这里最难的事情。

sentences.en: docs/PROTOCOL.md records what the interoperability literature contributed.
sentences.zh: docs/PROTOCOL.md 记录了互操作性文献的贡献。

blocks.html_en: Status

sentences.en: Status
sentences.zh: 地位

blocks.html_en: A working app that its author uses, not a product. It is macOS-first: the paths above are macOS paths, and nothing else has been tried. Expect rough edges, particularly around sandboxes, which are the newest part.

sentences.en: A working app that its author uses, not a product.
sentences.zh: 作者使用的可用应用程序，而不是产品。

sentences.en: It is macOS-first: the paths above are macOS paths, and nothing else has been tried.
sentences.zh: 它是 macOS 优先：上面的路径是 macOS 路径，没有尝试过其他路径。

sentences.en: Expect rough edges, particularly around sandboxes, which are the newest part.
sentences.zh: 预计会有粗糙的边缘，特别是在沙箱周围，这是最新的部分。

blocks.html_en: Credit

sentences.en: Credit
sentences.zh: 信用

blocks.html_en: The shape of this app, agents you talk to that also talk to each other in a room you can watch, is heavily inspired by Grok bot.

sentences.en: The shape of this app, agents you talk to that also talk to each other in a room you can watch, is heavily inspired by Grok bot.
sentences.zh: 这个应用程序的形状，即与您交谈的代理也可以在您可以观看的房间中相互交谈，很大程度上受到了 Grok 机器人的启发。

blocks.html_en: Its message layer is derived from the four agent interoperability protocols (MCP, ACP, A2A, ANP) and from the survey comparing them, A survey of agent interoperability protocols by Abul Ehtesham, Aditi Singh, Gaurav Kumar Gupta and Saket Kumar (arXiv 2505.02279). A2A in particular gave the Agent Card, discovery as a first-class operation, and card versioning. docs/PROTOCOL.md records what was taken from each, what was cut, and what had to be invented, chiefly termination, which none of them specify.

sentences.en: Its message layer is derived from the four agent interoperability protocols (MCP, ACP, A2A, ANP) and from the survey comparing them, A survey of agent interoperability protocols by Abul Ehtesham, Aditi Singh, Gaurav Kumar Gupta and Saket Kumar (arXiv 2505.02279).
sentences.zh: 它的消息层源自四种代理互操作性协议（MCP、ACP、A2A、ANP）以及对它们进行比较的调查，Abul Ehtesham、Aditi Singh、Gaurav Kumar Gupta 和 Saket Kumar 的代理互操作性协议调查 (arXiv 2505.02279)。

sentences.en: A2A in particular gave the Agent Card, discovery as a first-class operation, and card versioning.
sentences.zh: A2A 特别提供了代理卡、发现作为一流的操作以及卡版本控制。

sentences.en: docs/PROTOCOL.md records what was taken from each, what was cut, and what had to be invented, chiefly termination, which none of them specify.
sentences.zh: docs/PROTOCOL.md 记录了从每个协议中获取的内容、被删减的内容以及必须发明的内容，主要是终止，但它们都没有指定。

blocks.html_en: Connectors have two kinds rather than one because of Beyond Browsing: API-Based Web Agents by Yueqi Song, Frank Xu, Shuyan Zhou and Graham Neubig (arXiv 2410.16464). Putting API-calling and browsing agents on the same WebArena tasks, they found APIs beat browsing, and a hybrid that could choose beat both, by 24.0 points absolute over browsing alone. The design that follows is not "an API when there is one, a browser otherwise": it is telling one agent about both and letting it pick, which is what the prompt's What you can reach section is for.

sentences.en: Connectors have two kinds rather than one because of Beyond Browsing: API-Based Web Agents by Yueqi Song, Frank Xu, Shuyan Zhou and Graham Neubig (arXiv 2410.16464).
sentences.zh: 由于超越浏览，连接器有两种而不是一种：基于 API 的 Web 代理，作者：Yueqi Song、Frank Xu、Shuyan Zhou 和 Graham Neubig (arXiv 2410.16464)。

sentences.en: Putting API-calling and browsing agents on the same WebArena tasks, they found APIs beat browsing, and a hybrid that could choose beat both, by 24.0 points absolute over browsing alone.
sentences.zh: 将 API 调用和浏览代理放在相同的 WebArena 任务上，他们发现 API 击败了浏览，并且可以选择击败两者的混合体，绝对比单独浏览高 24.0 个百分点。

sentences.en: The design that follows is not "an API when there is one, a browser otherwise": it is telling one agent about both and letting it pick, which is what the prompt's What you can reach section is for.
sentences.zh: 接下来的设计不是“有 API 时为 API，否则为浏览器”：它告诉一个代理两者并让它进行选择，这就是提示的“您可以到达的内容”部分的用途。

blocks.html_en: The security half comes from BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents by Kaiyuan Zhang, Mark Tenenholtz, Kyle Polley, Jerry Ma, Denis Yarats and Ninghui Li (arXiv 2511.20597). Its useful move is to benchmark injections that drive real-world actions rather than text output, which is exactly what a signed-in session turns a web page into: the payload no longer has to talk an agent into obtaining access, because it already has the operator's. Guaca takes the architectural half of their defence-in-depth argument, which is what a local app can actually hold: page content is labelled at the point it enters the turn, credentials never enter the model's context at all, and the signed-in agent is told where to stop. Neither paper's authors endorse any of this.

content_html_zh:
一个本地桌面应用程序，您可以在其中与 LLM 代理交谈，并且这些代理可以相互交谈。 Slack 形状：左边是一排代理，右边是一个对话，以及一个显示他们之间发送的每条消息的活动视图。

向经理询问一些事情。 它找出团队中的哪些人可以提供帮助，向他们每人发送一条消息，然后他们立即思考而不是轮流思考。 你会看到它的发生：谁在打字，谁给谁写信，该小组到目前为止花了多少钱。 当他们完成后，你会得到一个答案，而不是一份需要费力阅读的文字记录。

一切都在您的机器上运行。 唯一剩下的就是您和您的代理键入的内容，发送到您指向的任何 OpenAI 兼容端点。

船员

其中十六人，每个特工一名。 它们不是装饰品：代理的特征就是你在八个代理中找到它的样子，并且它随时都在做某事。 空闲时它会眨眼并环顾四周，看向正在写信的人，当消息发出时它会结束并抛出，当消息到达时它会明显受到打击。 在你读完其中的一个字之前，观察铁路就可以告诉你你的工作人员在做什么。

Run it

pnpm install
pnpm app          # dev, with hot reload
pnpm app:build    # an installable bundle

打开“设置”，输入您的姓名和 OpenRouter 密钥，然后按“测试连接”，这将分别检查端点、密钥和型号。 您可以找出哪一个是错误的，而不是看着特工保持沉默。

端点是可配置的，因此本地 llama.cpp 或 LM Studio 服务器无需更改代码即可工作。 将推理端点指向它，如果不需要，则将密钥留空。

尝试一下它的用途

  1. 第一次运行时，选择添加新手团队：经理、研究员、评论家和抄写员。
  2. 打开管理器并向您的团队发送自我介绍。
  3. 注意铁轨。 代理之间的每条消息都会以发送者的颜色绘制在它们之间传播的脉冲。
  4. 打开任何其他代理以查看它收到的内容，或者打开活动视图以序列图形式查看整个事件，每次运行一个板。

消息传递始终是异步的。 经理不等待研究员；所有四个同伴同时思考。

代理人可以做什么

八种工具，向模型描述并在使用时在脚本中可见：

Tool 它的作用
目录 列出其组中的其他特工及其技能
发送消息 将消息排队到其中一个或多个，然后返回
更新说明 重写自己的记忆，每回合都会显示该记忆
日程 设置或取消自己的例程
运行命令 自己机器上的 shell
在桌面上打开 在该机器的屏幕上启动一些内容
使用屏幕 看屏幕、点击、输入
浏览 通过 DevTools 协议驱动 Chrome

后四项需要电脑，可选；见下文。

团体

组是一个隔离边界。 不同组中的代理无法互相查看或发送消息，并且无法解析另一个组中的名称。 它读起来就像一个不属于任何人的名字，因此无法跨界探查名单。

每个组都可以固定自己的模型、端点和密钥。 设置通过应用程序解决组上的代理问题，因此昂贵的人员和便宜的人员可以并肩运行。

每个组标题都带有运行的令牌计数、成本和最后 90 秒的迷你图，因此正在执行自己任务的工作人员看起来与陷入困境的工作人员不同。

记忆和惯例

每个代理都有一个用 update_notes 维护的注释文件，在每个回合开始时显示给它。 这是对话之间唯一存在的东西。 您可以在代理编辑器中阅读和编辑它。

代理还可以保留自己的时间表：“每五个小时检查一次列表”是一个例行程序，存储为下一个到期时间而不是计时器，因此它可以在重新启动后继续存在。 例程列在代理编辑器中，可以手动编写、重新定时和删除。

电脑

配置 E2B 密钥后，可以为代理提供一台带有桌面、浏览器和 shell 的 Linux 计算机。 屏幕出现在其频道的一角：阅读时显示实时图片，展开时可进行交互。

  • 机器在十五分钟空闲后进入睡眠状态并保留其磁盘，因此它醒来时仍然登录到它所登录的任何内容。
  • 沙箱是私有的，查看器是一个保存访问令牌的环回代理，因此到达计算机的 URL 永远不会被猜测或暴露给 Web 视图。
  • 没有实时代理引用的机器将在下次启动时发布。 一个被遗忘的沙箱的账单与用过的沙箱一模一样。

如果没有 E2B 密钥，这些都不会出现，并且不会提供其他四个工具。

连接器

拥有计算机的代理几乎可以达到任何目标。 它不能做的是知道它已经被允许进入的内容：将其浏览器登录到 LinkedIn，但它仍然会告诉您它无法发帖。 访问从未丢失。 知识是。

两份，哪一份是由服务决定的，而不是由偏好决定的。

在代理的计算机上登录。 打开其屏幕，登录您喜欢的任何内容，这就是整个过程。 任何地方都没有声明任何内容：Chrome 保存着 cookie，因此 Guaca 会询问浏览器它登录的是什么，并将答案放入该代理的提示和所有其他代理的名册中。 注销后它也会以同样的方式消失。 没有地方可以输入密码，因为 Guaca 从来不处理密码。

凭据，在组中。 对于具有普通令牌的 API，请将其粘贴到组的设置中并命名一个变量。 该组中的每台计算机都会在其运行的每个命令的环境中获取它。

从每一半的实际居住地点可以得出两件事，并且两者都是承重的：

  • 浏览器会话是一台机器上的cookie，因此它属于一个代理。 其他船员被告知谁持有该技能，在列出技能的同一个名册中，因此要求在 LinkedIn 上发布信息的特工会说“研究员可以做到这一点”，而不是“我没有登录”。 技能是代理人对自己写的声明；会话是从磁盘读取的事实。
  • 凭证是一个字符串，因此整个组都会获取它，但它永远不会到达模型。 它从 SQLite 进入沙箱命令的环境，而不是其他地方：不进入提示，不进入脚本，不进入 webview，不进入沙箱磁盘。 代理被告知变量的名称并被告知不要打印它。

检测是故意谨慎的，因为错误的声明比丢失的声明更糟糕：一个认为自己可以读取 Gmail 的代理浪费了一个时间发现它不能，并且您看到的是一个损坏的帐户而不是一个缺失的帐户。 站点通过 cookie 进行识别，这实际上意味着有人登录，因此持有在注销时收集的 google.com cookie 的浏览器会正确报告为已注销。 任何不在该列表中的内容只有在浏览器真正访问过它并持有暗示身份的 cookie 时才会被提及，并且它会作为可能传递给代理。 在包含 300 个域的 1000 个 cookie 的真实配置文件中，该组合准确地报告了机器实际拥有的一个帐户。

已识别的服务列表位于domain/signin.rs 中，添加一个就是一行。 没有 OAuth：本地开源应用程序无法诚实地提供“使用 Google 登录”，因为 Gmail 范围受到限制并且验证是针对每个应用程序的。 今天，通过代理自己的浏览器登录即可使用 Gmail，就像人们使用的同一扇门一样。

登录也是恶意网页值得编写的原因，因此代理读取的每个页面都会被标记为内容而不是指令，并且系统提示会说明登录代理必须停止的操作。 参见信用。

Data

所有内容都位于一个目录中：

~/Library/Application Support/com.madebywelch.guac/
  guac.db        agents, groups, messages, routines, usage
  config.json    settings, written 0600
  workspace/     one markdown file per agent: its notes

API 密钥以明文形式存储在 config.json 中。 Guaca 是一个没有身份验证的本地应用程序，用旁边的密钥加密的密钥将是剧院。 诚实的答案是操作系统钥匙串，这是有意的后续行动，而不是这里伪造的东西。

删除代理是一种软删除：它离开了轨道，再也不能发送消息，它的计算机被破坏，它的笔记也消失了，但它已经说过的内容仍然可读，它的名字可以自由重复使用。 重新开始一个团队会重置整个团队（记录、例程、笔记和支出），同时保留特工本身。

正在努力

./scripts/ci.sh          # lint, typecheck, build, every suite
GUAC_LOG=guac=debug pnpm app

AGENTS.md 是一个简短的版本，适用于任何想要改变某些事情的人，无论是人类还是其他人：什么是令人惊讶的，什么会咬人，以及如何检查。 docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 是长版本，包括为什么代理对话结束而不是永远循环，这是这里最难的事情。 docs/PROTOCOL.md 记录了互操作性文献的贡献。

地位

作者使用的可用应用程序，而不是产品。 它是 macOS 优先：上面的路径是 macOS 路径，没有尝试过其他路径。 预计会有粗糙的边缘，特别是在沙箱周围，这是最新的部分。

信用

这个应用程序的形状，即与您交谈的代理也可以在您可以观看的房间中相互交谈，很大程度上受到了 Grok 机器人的启发。

它的消息层源自四种代理互操作性协议（MCP、ACP、A2A、ANP）以及对它们进行比较的调查，Abul Ehtesham、Aditi Singh、Gaurav Kumar Gupta 和 Saket Kumar 的代理互操作性协议调查 (arXiv 2505.02279)。 A2A 特别提供了代理卡、发现作为一流的操作以及卡版本控制。 docs/PROTOCOL.md 记录了从每个协议中获取的内容、被删减的内容以及必须发明的内容，主要是终止，但它们都没有指定。

由于超越浏览，连接器有两种而不是一种：基于 API 的 Web 代理，作者：Yueqi Song、Frank Xu、Shuyan Zhou 和 Graham Neubig (arXiv 2410.16464)。 将 API 调用和浏览代理放在相同的 WebArena 任务上，他们发现 API 击败了浏览，并且可以选择击败两者的混合体，绝对比单独浏览高 24.0 个百分点。 接下来的设计不是“有 API 时为 API，否则为浏览器”：它告诉一个代理两者并让它进行选择，这就是提示的“您可以到达的内容”部分的用途。

安全部分来自 BrowseSafe: Understanding and Preventing Prompt Injection Within AI Browser Agents，作者为 Kaiyuan Zhang、Mark Tenenholtz、Kyle Polley、Jerry Ma、Denis Yarats 和 Ninghui Li (arXiv 2511.20597)。 其有用的举措是对驱动现实世界操作而不是文本输出的注入进行基准测试，这正是登录会话将网页转变为的内容：有效负载不再需要说服代理获取访问权限，因为它已经拥有操作员的访问权限。 Guaca 采用了他们的深度防御论点的架构部分，这就是本地应用程序实际上可以容纳的内容：页面内容在进入回合时被标记，凭证根本不会进入模型的上下文，并且登录的代理被告知在哪里停止。 这两篇论文的作者都不认可这一点。
